name: Social Proof for WooCommerce
author: ParagonWP

sections.description:
Social Proof for WooCommerce is social proof plugin for WooCommerce websites.

It is an eCommerce tool that lets websites show their latest orders. The plugin is built for WooCommerce websites, and is compatible with any website running on WooCommerce.

NEW IN VERSION 1.3:
* Enhanced Analytics Dashboard with comprehensive debugging tools
* Added conditional debug mode for analytics troubleshooting
* Fixed date range picker functionality with proper JavaScript dependencies
* Improved admin page slug from ‘ig-woo_proof’ to ‘wooproof’ for better consistency
* Fixed security nonce verification issues in analytics forms
* Added click tracking test functionality for administrators
* Enhanced popup layout and click detection reliability
* Improved settings form handling with proper checkbox validation
* Added debug information panels showing table status and configuration
* Enhanced error handling and user feedback for analytics operations
* Fixed JavaScript timing issues with document ready events
* Improved admin interface with conditional feature display

PREVIOUS VERSION 1.2:
* Complete codebase refactored to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* Improved code organization with proper class structure and namespaces
* Enhanced maintainability and extensibility for future development
* Better security with improved input sanitization and validation
* Dependency injection pattern implemented for better testability
* PSR-4 compliant autoloading for optimized performance
* Backward compatibility maintained – no breaking changes for existing users

VERSION 1.1:
* Full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
* Updated for latest WooCommerce versions (tested up to 9.3.0)
* Improved order querying performance

GENERIC FEATURES:

  • Easy to set up, simple settings
  • A neat design of the popups
  • No signups or 3rd party integration required
  • Fits equally on all screen sizes
  • A lightweight plugin that doesn’t affect your website performance
  • Modern Object-Oriented codebase for better performance and maintainability
  • Enhanced security with proper input validation and sanitization
  • No external font loading for optimal performance and privacy
  • Uses system fonts for faster loading and better user experience

CORE FEATURES:

  • Choose the number of orders to display
  • Set a minimum product price
  • Choose whether to repeat the popup or stop after the set number of orders are displayed
  • Choose whether to display the “Verified by Ilmigo” label or not
  • Choose whether to display the order time (i.e. days ago, minutes ago, etc)?
  • Configure delay, timing, duration, etc.
  • Set expiration time for a cookie to prevent the popup from trigger after it is closed by the user
  • Options to show the popups sitewide, on specific posts/pages, categories, etc.
  • An option for resetting the settings to defaults
  • A graph to see the click analytics visually
  • Show real names and locations of buyers
  • Popups link directly to product URLs
sections.installation:
• The plugin is an extension of WooCommerce plugin. So make sure your site has WooCommerce installed prior to installing this plugin.
  • Install Social Proof for WooCommerce via the plugin directory, or upload the files manually to your server.
sections.changelog:
1.3

  • Enhanced Analytics Dashboard: Added comprehensive debugging tools and status information
  • Fixed Date Range Picker: Resolved JavaScript dependency issues with moment.js and daterangepicker
  • Improved Admin Interface: Changed admin page slug from ‘ig-woo_proof’ to ‘wooproof’ for consistency
  • Enhanced Security: Fixed nonce verification issues in analytics forms and AJAX requests
  • Added Debug Mode: Conditional debug features including click tracking tests and table status
  • Fixed Click Tracking: Improved popup layout and click detection reliability
  • Better Form Handling: Enhanced settings form processing with proper checkbox validation
  • Added Testing Tools: Click tracking test button and sample data generation for administrators
  • Improved Error Handling: Better user feedback and error reporting in analytics operations
  • Enhanced JavaScript: Fixed timing issues with document ready events and script dependencies
  • Admin UX Improvements: Conditional display of debug features based on user settings
  • Fixed Analytics Display: Proper handling of date range submissions and chart rendering

1.2

  • Major codebase refactoring: Complete migration to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Implemented proper class structure with namespaces (ParagonWP\SocialProof)
  • Added dependency injection pattern for better code organization
  • Enhanced security with improved input sanitization and nonce verification
  • PSR-4 compliant autoloading for better performance
  • Separated concerns into dedicated classes: Database, Settings, Admin, Frontend, Analytics, Ajax
  • Improved maintainability and extensibility for future development
  • Backward compatibility maintained – no data loss or breaking changes
  • Better error handling and debugging capabilities
  • Code now follows WordPress coding standards and best practices
  • Fixed missing plugin enable/disable setting that was preventing social proof from displaying
  • Removed Google Fonts dependency for better performance and privacy compliance
  • Replaced external fonts with optimized system font stack for faster loading
  • Fixed “Display Order Time” setting functionality – now properly shows/hides timestamps
  • Removed deprecated “Verified by WooProof” setting for cleaner admin interface
  • Added comprehensive debug mode for administrators to troubleshoot display issues
  • Improved settings validation and checkbox/radio field handling

1.1

  • Added full compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Updated WooCommerce compatibility to version 9.3.0
  • Improved order querying performance and efficiency
  • Fixed redundant order object calls
  • Updated WordPress compatibility to version 6.6

1.0

  • Initial release
  • Social proof notifications for WooCommerce stores
  • Customizable popup settings and display options
  • Analytics tracking for popup interactions
